title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1979-12-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.0.1 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A superb audience recording that captures a beautifully performed Brokedown Palace with vivid venue acoustics.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the life‑filled sound of this audience (AUD) tape, noting that the venue’s acoustics really shine. The performance is described as "simply beautiful" with a standout rendition of Brokedown Palace, making the set highly enjoyable despite the limited commentary on individual songs or band members.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are overwhelmingly positive about both the sound and the music; however only two reviews are available, so the rating reflects strong show and recording quality but limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers praise the AUD for its vivid life compared to soundboard tapes, noting excellent venue acoustics and a clear, immersive mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focused on overall beauty of the performance.
